name: First Presbyterian Church Courtyard and Grounds
description: A commercial courtyard and front-grounds rebuild at First Presbyterian Church in Bennettsville: herringbone paver walks, new sod, mulched planting beds, and screening that holds up next to a public street and a playground.
metaDescription: Courtyard and front-grounds rebuild at First Presbyterian Church in Bennettsville: paver walks, new sod, mulched beds, and street-side screening.
story: The church sits on a downtown block in Bennettsville, with the sanctuary, a playground, and the sidewalk all in the same view. The grounds needed to look finished from the street and still take daily foot traffic between the entry, the courtyard, and the play area. We rebuilt the outdoor rooms as one job: tan brick paver walks in a herringbone pattern, new sod on the lawn panels, and deep mulch beds with shrubs, specimen trees, and an evergreen screen along the fence. The front of the church got the same treatment around the monument sign and the steps, so the property reads as one campus instead of leftover lawn next to a courtyard. The result is a commercial landscape the congregation can use and the street can see—clean edges, defined walks, and planting that will fill in without constant patching.
